brief_feedback: Whole image and both supplied halves were each displayed exactly once. Thirteen unresolved loci were written down after the half views, then each received one logged enhanced crop; all thirteen crop images were displayed. Every C uncertainty and every substantive page-specific context observation has an explicit decision. H is descriptive only, so no H collation rows were manufactured. The full inventory separates each reference-level correction entry and all nested cancellations, underlines, the insertion, margin note and drawings; there are no standalone displays or diagrams. The pair of vertical rules is represented with zero-width TikZ anchors and an overlay, preserving their physical sides relative to the correction text; no compilation was attempted. The isolated formula does not give a mathematical assertion whose truth can be checked from this page alone; math_checks is empty rather than counting glyph inspection as proof. The supplied conventions state first-occurrence treatment for recurring glyph ambiguity, but the later brief explicitly requires each independently unclear occurrence to be marked; all three p167 superscripts are marked accordingly.
